notes.title: A brand new Infinity Girl Demo: The Drifter Update
notes.notes:
Hey everybody! Just in time for the Dreamhack Festival on Steam, a BIG new Infinity Girl demo just dropped. It's basically a free mini roguelike at this point: 7 levels of hypnotic, high-speed goodness. I'm using these demo updates to test new features that will go into the game's alpha version -- would love your feedback! There is a LOT new stuff in this version including:


 A new set of outdoor levels (which feature a slick new procedural level generation system that lets me place obstacles, rails, coins and other objects across huge spaces)
 Mario Kart-style drifting, including a "drift blast" when you let go of the drift button (I'm biased but this is my favorite addition -- so much fun to drift and boost around these levels)
 A new "Beat the clock" feature in every level that encourages you to go fast (by rewarding you with coins for getting to the goal more quickly). 
 Less float-y physics and less slippery handling
 A second, advanced tutorial level to teach drifting, air banking and more
 Better controls (including smooth left and right banking when you hold the L/R triggers -- this helps landing tricky jumps)
 A few quality of life improvements for the streamers out there: volume controls and a windowed mode
 Performance improvements, especially reductions in level loading time
 Wider levels across the entire game: More space to drift, and less chances to fall to your death ☠️ 


As always, let me know what you think of the new additions in the Infinity Girl discord. Thanks!

notes.title: Infinity Girl: The Charged Update
notes.notes:
Hey everybody! I just pushed a new demo build of Infinity Girl with a TON of big updates. I'm continuing to iterate on the alpha demo based on streamers' videos and other feedback. I'm basically treating it like a baby alpha version of the game as I tune the difficulty and the core loops of Infinity Girl.
Major updates in this version include:


 The Right Shoulder button can now trigger secondary abilities!  So now instead of losing your dash ability (Y button) you can purchase another power to suit your playstyle during each run. Which brings me to...
 I added a few new roguelike abilities you can purchase at the end of levels, including:
     Kinetic sloth: a secondary ability that makes everything go into slow motion for 4 bars
     Mega dash: dash, but BIG
     Slow blast: go into slow mo during brake blasts for extra precision during chaotic moments
 Charge meter: If you stay on beat for sixteen beats, you get a charge to use your dash or second ability. By default, you can currently have up to four charges, which is very overpowered atm lol. This will probably turn into abilities in future builds, so enjoy the OP default build while it lasts 😄 
 Abilities/powers no longer duplicate, and now appear as fancy cards at the end of each level!
 More Grind rails! I already had them in the 4th level, and now they will frequently appear on levels 1 and 3 as well. This makes the first few levels even faster and more fun.
 Lots of adjustments to the difficulty, includes less obstacles, more plentiful lives (you get a bonus life every 25 coins now), more coins, fewer tricky jumps and a roguelite perma-upgrade path to get more starting lives more quickly across multiple runs.
 The updated demo is now live on Steam! Enjoy! 🏃‍♀️

PS If you want to help me shape the game, join us over on the Infinity Girl discord! https://discord.gg/CWcSKhqXQ
-Adam (solo dev/music producer behind Infinity Girl)
